quotient_definition: Each row-local conflict was reduced to a deletion-minimal arithmetic premise set and quotiented by exact colored-graph isomorphism under good relabeling and same-colored-premise relabeling.
meaning: The 955-conflict Hall certificate does not collapse to a small family under the tested exact row-local symmetry: 926 row-local conflicts still occupy 397 templates. This is a calibrated negative proof-mining result, not an EFX theorem.
claim_boundary: This is an exact diagnostic for one seed-derived fixed candidate cell. It neither proves the adaptive-priority completion conjecture nor proves complete additive EFX for four agents. It also does not rule out a stronger analytic quotient using structure absent from the tested colored-graph equivalence.
